# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Glyph to be a project where anyone can contribute without being
harassed, belittled, or shut out. We pledge to make participation a harassment-
free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity,
sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Behavior that helps the community:

- Being kind and assuming good faith.
- Keeping disagreement technical and specific.
- Accepting constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its users.

Behavior that is not acceptable:

- Harassment, insults, or derogatory comments, public or private.
- Personal or political attacks.
- Publishing others' private information without permission.
- Sustained disruption of discussion.
- Other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Scope

This applies in all project spaces, GitHub issues and pull requests,
discussions, and any channel that represents the project, and when an individual
is representing the project in public.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainers at **conduct@glyphlang.io**. All
reports are reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly, and the reporter's
privacy is respected. Maintainers who do not follow or enforce this Code in good
faith may face temporary or permanent repercussions as determined by the rest of
the maintainers.

Maintainers may take any action they deem appropriate, from a private warning to
a temporary or permanent ban, in response to behavior they consider a violation.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor
Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
